questions.prompt: SURVIVOR PRIZE MONEY: Adjusting for inflation, which is worth MORE?
questions.explanation: $1,000,000 in 2000 × (332 ÷ 172) = $1,930,233 in 2026 dollars — less than the $2,000,000 prize in 2026. So the 2026 prize is worth MORE.

questions.prompt: AIR JORDANS: Adjusting for inflation, which is cheaper?
questions.explanation: $56.95 in 1985 × (332 ÷ 108) = $175.07 in 2026 dollars — more than the $149.99 paid in 2026. So the 2026 pair is cheaper.

questions.prompt: 27" TELEVISION: Adjusting for inflation, which is cheaper?
questions.explanation: $279.95 in 1953 × (332 ÷ 27) = $3,442.35 in 2026 dollars — far more than the $199.99 paid in 2026. So the 2026 TV is cheaper.

questions.prompt: LOS ANGELES HOUSE: Adjusting for inflation, which is cheaper?
questions.explanation: $43,500 in 1976 × (296 ÷ 57) = $225,895 in 2022 dollars — far less than the $911,963 paid in 2022. So the 1976 house is cheaper.

questions.prompt: BIG MAC: Adjusting for inflation, which is cheaper?
questions.explanation: $0.49 in 1968 × (332 ÷ 35) = $4.65 in 2026 dollars — less than the $6.72 paid in 2026. So the 1968 Big Mac is cheaper.

questions.prompt: FORD SEDAN: Adjusting for inflation, which is cheaper?
questions.explanation: $850 in 1909 × (259 ÷ 9) = $24,461 in 2020 dollars — more than the $23,170 paid in 2020. So the 2020 Ford is cheaper.
